title: SDK Labs: activation-to-retention orchestration and signal harmonization
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: We see a ~28% drop between 'first SDK import + run' and 'second successful run within 7 days' across sample quickstarts. That leakage prevents customers from reaching the runway where Redwood Optimize recommendations and batching savings become meaningful. Objective: define and ship an operationalized orchestration and measurement surface (SDK Labs runway) that increases 7-day repeat-run by 15pp for new cohorts and creates a repeatable funnel that product and growth can iterate on. Scope: short-term orchestration (1) event-driven follow-ups in quickstarts (email/snippets), (2) in-SDK first-time UX hooks (guided prompts, telemetry opt-in), and (3) dashboards + alerting for cohort-level retention and quality regressions. Out of scope for this ticket: paid acquisition experiments and dedicated customer success outreach playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Instrumentation: cohort event stream (import, first-run, subsequent-run, error, latencies) present in analytics dashboard with cohort filter. 2) Two lightweight in-SDK hooks shipped: interactive quickstart hint and optional telemetry opt-in; visible in at least one official SDK repo. 3) Automated cohort retention dashboard with a clear baseline and a calculation that shows weekly 7-day repeat-run metric. 4) Runbook drafted for on-call/product on how to triage retention drops with ownership and remediation steps. 5) A/B pilot launched with at least 1,000 new users in the test cohort and early performance signal within 4 weeks.
metrics_and_targets: Baseline 7-day repeat-run = 28%. Target = 43% (+15pp) for SDK Labs cohorts within 8 weeks of pilot start. Secondary: reduce first-run error rate from 9% to <=5%; increase telemetry opt-in to >=35% of new users. Track cohorts weekly in analytics-dashboard.redwood.com -> SDK Labs runway.
milestones: 1) 2025-11-10: finalize instrumentation schema and events (ENG sign-off). 2) 2025-11-24: land SDK quickstart hint + telemetry opt-in PR. 3) 2025-12-08: dashboard v1 with cohort filters and alerts. 4) 2025-12-15: roll A/B pilot to 20% traffic; monitor for 2 weeks. 5) 2026-01-15: evaluate pilot, docs, and runbook; prepare rollout recommendation.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Additional telemetry increases privacy concerns and may hurt conversion. Mitigation: telemetry opt-in is explicit, minimal PII, and documented in the quickstart README; security will sign off. Risk: Dashboard noise from bot traffic. Mitigation: add bot filter heuristics and a 'verified dev' flag for cohort membership. Risk: Changes to SDK might cause regression in some enterprise environments. Mitigation: canary to 5% and dedicated rollback path in release notes.
notes: Decision: prioritize non-invasive client-side hints first (low lift) before server-driven engagement. Trade-off: slower adoption of telemetry but better trust and fewer compliance blockers. We will iterate the hint content in 'SDK Labs creative brief' (Confluence) before landing code.
